scorer_audit_findings.root_cause_of_66_string_differences: In `dev72-corpus.json` and `heldout46-corpus.json`, the C26 corpus oracle stores squared rational values (`x^2 in Q`) for `measure == 'len'` (e.g. `'27'` for `3√3`, `'9/2'` for `3√2/2`) and `cos^2` for `measure == 'cos2'` (e.g. `'1/3'` for `cos²=1/3`), whereas `Adapter /4` outputs canonical unsquared radical strings (`'3√3'`, `'3√2/2'`) and `'cos²=1/3'`. In addition, `evaluate_local_first_understanding.py` sorted `answers` and `expected_answers` lexicographically as flat lists instead of binding by `goal_id`. When bound 1-to-1 by `goal_id` and converted via `canonical_sqrt_fraction(Fraction(val))` / `f'cos²={Fraction(val)}'`, all 66 cases (103/103 scalar goals) match 100% with 0 mathematical discrepancies.

exact_kernel_multi_solution_audit.sign_enumeration_formula: 2^(m-1) sign combinations over Off-diagonal Gram entries where G_ii > 0 (Fixing sign_0 = +1 to quotient global reflection O(3)/SO(3))
exact_kernel_multi_solution_audit.isometry_quotient_soundness: Fixing the first non-zero normal coordinate sign (`signs = [1] + rest`) quotients global reflection across the anchor plane, which is an orientation-reversing isometry preserving all lengths, angles, areas, and volumes. Relative sign choices among `m >= 2` points (`2^(m-1)` branches) represent distinct metric configurations (same-side vs opposite-side of the anchor plane) when `d^2(p_i, p_j)` is constrained; if `d^2(p_i, p_j)` is unconstrained (`Not in d2`), `_giai_he_gram_3d` returns `None` (`UNDERDETERMINED_METRIC`), preventing silent arbitrary branch selection.
